composition_subtypes.role: Preprocess cards into two lists sorted by custom keys (a descending, b ascending)
Linear scan merging the two sorted lists to form connected components

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts cards into two lists, then processes with amortized two-pointer technique to partition into segments and compute minimum flips
payload.rationale: The algorithm first sorts cards by decreasing a and increasing b, then uses two pointers that only advance, total O(n), which is a composition of sorting and amortized two-pointer merging.
